ideas.description: Close crosses above the upper 50-day 2-sigma band with CMF21 > 0.05 above the 200-day; exit when %B falls under 0.5 or CMF < -0.05.

what_it_does.buy: bb_pctb(50, 2) crosses above 1 and cmf(21) is above 0.05 and close is above sma(200)
what_it_does.sell: bb_pctb(50, 2) is below 0.5 or cmf(21) is below -0.05
what_it_does.order: buys the most heavily traded names first
what_it_does.size: up to 10 stocks at 10% of the account each

indicators.label: bb_pctb(50, 2)
indicators.about: Bollinger %B: 0 at the lower band, 1 at the upper band.

indicators.label: cmf(21)
indicators.about: Chaikin money flow, -1 to +1: volume-weighted closing position within each day's range.

notes: NEW (Bollinger band ride): close crosses above upper 50-day 2-sigma band with CMF21 > 0.05 above the 200-day; exit %B < 0.5 or CMF < -0.05. Exposure stayed 94% across a broad universe (always 10 names riding a band), and the mid-band exit churns: high turnover, half SPY's CAGR.

ideas.description: Close above the prior 55-day high on rel_volume > 2 while ATR20% < 2.5% above the 200-day; exit on a close under the 50-day.

indicators.label: donchian_high(55)
indicators.about: Highest high of the previous length bars (excludes today, for breakouts).

indicators.label: rel_volume(50)
